messages.content:
Bạn rút thông tin từ một CV đã được ẩn thông tin liên hệ.

Trả về DUY NHẤT JSON:
{"nam_hoc": int|null, "nganh": str|null, "gpa": number|null, "thanh_pho": str|null,
 "ky_nang": [str], "project": str|null, "co_github": true|false}

LUẬT:
- CV không ghi rõ field nào thì để null / mảng rỗng. TUYỆT ĐỐI không suy đoán.
  Không có GPA thì là null — đừng ước lượng từ học lực.
- KHÔNG trả về tên người, email, số điện thoại, link, địa chỉ, số CCCD, tên trường
  dù chúng có xuất hiện. Chỉ 7 field trên.
- `gpa` quy về thang 4. CV ghi thang 10 thì chia 2.5 và làm tròn 2 số.
- `ky_nang` là tên công nghệ/kỹ năng cụ thể, tối đa 10 mục.
- `co_github` = true nếu CV có nhắc tới GitHub/GitLab/portfolio code, KỂ CẢ khi
  đường link đã bị thay bằng [LINK]. Đây chỉ là cờ true/false — TUYỆT ĐỐI không
  chép lại đường link vào bất kỳ field nào.

NGUYEN PHUONG NAM
AI INTERNSHIP
 [PHONE]✉ [EMAIL][LINK] Hai Ba Trung, Hanoi
CAREER OBJECTIVE
Computer Science student and AI enthusiast with hands-on experience building and deploying computer vision systems for real-world retail
and manufacturing applications. Skilled in object detection, multi-object tracking, and cross-camera re-identification, with experience
deploying models on edge devices. Seeking a Computer Vision / Machine Learning Engineer role to contribute to production AI systems and
grow into a specialized ML Engineer.
WORK EXPERIENCE
AVIC 3-2026- 7-2026
AI Engineer Intern
1. Built an end-to-end pipeline: person detection (YOLO26) → per-camera tracking (ByteTrack) → QR/noQR classification (EfficientNet-
B0) → cross-camera re-identification (TransReID).
2. Trained TransReID on a self-collected upbody-crop dataset in Market-1501 format; labeled cross-camera identities using OSNet
embeddings + Union-Find clustering.
3. Tuned the ReID cosine-similarity threshold and classifier decision threshold to balance Precision/Recall, reducing cross-camera identity
mismatches and false positives on imbalanced data.
4. Built an entrance counting system tracking customer in/out flow using person detection + trajectory-based tracking.
5. Designed zone-based counting logic to determine In/Out direction from each person's movement trajectory rather than simple line-
crossing; achieved ~95% counting accuracy on real-world data.
EDUCATION
Hanoi University of Industry (HaUI) 2022- 2026
Computer Science
Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Data Structures & Algorithms.
SKILL
Computer Vision YOLOv8, Object Tracking (ByteTrack/DeepSORT), Face Recognition (InsightFace/ArcFace), OpenCV
Frameworks & Models PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras; CNN, ResNet, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet
Tools & Deployment Docker, Flask, Streamlit, Git; Jetson edge deployment
PROJECTS
AI Video Dubbing System | Tech: Openai flask sql marianMT 2- 2026- 6 - 2026
Source: [LINK]
Built an automatic English video dubbing pipeline: Speech-to-Text (Whisper) → Translation (OpenAI / MarianMT) → Text-to-Speech →
video composition. Designed a modular architecture allowing users to switch between online (OpenAI) and offline (MarianMT) translation
engines; demoed through a Streamlit interface.
Tech: Python, Whisper, OpenAI, MarianMT, Streamlit
Traffic Light Violation Detection | Tech: Python, YOLOv8, ByteTrack/DeepSORT, OpenCV 3 - 2026- 5 - 2026
Source: [LINK]
Built a computer vision system to detect red-light violations from traffic video. Used YOLOv8 to detect vehicles and ByteTrack/DeepSORT to
track them across frames, flagging vehicles that cross the stop line while the light is red. Defined a region of interest and stop line, then applied
tracking-based logic to identify each violating vehicle.
Face Recognition Attendance System| Tech: Python, InsightFace, ArcFace, OpenCV 9- 2025- 10 - 2025
Source: [LINK]
Built a face recognition system for automated attendance. Used InsightFace (RetinaFace for detection, ArcFace for embeddings) to detect and
identify faces from a webcam feed, matching them against a registered gallery to log attendance automatically.
CERTIFICATE
Machine Learning Specialization 2025
Deep Learning Specialization 2025
